title: A Rainy Day and a Sunny Day
text:
It is raining today. Ali wears a red coat and blue boots. He takes an umbrella because it is cold and wet outside.

In summer, Ali wears a white shirt and shorts. The sun is hot and the sky is blue. Ali feels happy on sunny days.

questions.text: What does Ali wear in summer?
Why does Ali take an umbrella?
What is the best guess about why Ali wears shorts in summer?

vocabulary.definition: an object you hold over your head to stay dry
short trousers that end above the knees

paragraph_translations: Bugün yağmur yağıyor. Ali kırmızı bir mont ve mavi bot giyiyor. Dışarısı soğuk ve ıslak olduğu için şemsiye alıyor.
Yazın Ali beyaz bir gömlek ve şort giyer. Güneş sıcak ve gökyüzü mavi. Ali güneşli günlerde mutlu hisseder.
